pages.title: The Solids
pages.text: The fountain also weeps what my rites are made of. An $(item)Ember of Wrath$(), a $(item)Tear of Sorrow$() and a $(item)Spore of Corruption$() at its first tier. A $(item)Mourning Pearl$() at its second, $(item)Rift Silk$() at its third. Nothing else makes them.

pages.title: The Rest
pages.text: At the altar I make the others from those. $(item)Bone Ink$() at the first tier, $(item)Rift Alloy$() and $(item)Echo Ink$() at the second, $(item)Void Ink$() and the $(item)Abyssal Core$() at the third.$(br2)Every structure past its first tier asks for some. The great works ask for the dearest.

pages.title: Kindling
pages.text: Some of them burn as well. An Ember pressed to a Killing Pit makes it work half again as hard for a minute. A Tear does the same for a Lament Well, a Spore for a Resonator. A Mourning Pearl makes a fountain weep twice as fast for two minutes. The time adds up.
